Train one linear layer on frozen features. Measures how linearly separable the representation is; the floor for transfer.

front: Which two accuracies to report in transfer learning?
back: Frozen (linear-probe) accuracy as the floor and fine-tuned accuracy as the ceiling; fine-tuned below frozen signals a bug.
